scope: Local SQLite, trusted simulated adapters only; no real clients, mail, provider calls or production certification.
checks: Authenticated reception and durable idempotency
Canonical property order does not create conflicts
Invalid signature, expired envelope and oversize body fail before persistence
Missing information is pending, never enters production
Unknown fields and secrets are rejected
All six stages reach mail acceptance with simulated adapters only
Failed tests trigger repair; a new revision is required
Persistent test failure stops after the configured repair limit
Certificate from another order or revision cannot activate
Duplicate required checks fail certification
Client identity and permissions cannot be substituted by provisioner
Concurrent workers acquire a single lease
Lost leases do not overwrite another worker or send mail
Wrong cabin origin, client or missing readiness prevents delivery
Missing mail config preserves active access and blocks unattended loops
Ambiguous mail response retries the same idempotency key without reactivation
Transient adapter errors have a finite retry budget
Service credentials are independent from visitor identity
Operator-only board rejects anonymous and unrelated clients
Board never declares unverified production readiness
Records survive restart of the database process
Missing fields can be completed by signed trigger without changing approved fields
Configuration resume is operator-only, same-origin and cannot skip certification
Incomplete orders still reject invalid fields and nested secrets
Null fields are rejected instead of creating permanently incomplete orders
One permitted repair means initial test plus one repaired revision
Receipt failure rolls back new order creation atomically
Receipt failure rolls back completion of missing fields
